About STYLO

STYLO is an AI-powered personal styling platform designed to transform the way people dress. We believe that looking stylish doesn’t mean buying more clothes — it means making better use of what you already own. Our platform helps you discover new outfit combinations from your existing wardrobe with personalized styling recommendations based on occasion, weather, comfort, body shape, and your unique preferences.

Why We Created STYLO

Have you ever stood in front of a wardrobe full of clothes and still felt like you had nothing to wear? You’re not alone. Many people repeat the same outfits or buy new clothes when they already have plenty of options. STYLO was created to solve this everyday problem by making personal styling simpler, smarter, and more accessible.

What We Do

  • AI-Powered Styling: Discover outfit ideas tailored to your preferences and needs.
  • One Item, 5 Looks: Find five different ways to style a single clothing item.
  • Get the Look: Recreate outfit inspirations using clothes you already own.
  • Travel Stylist: Plan outfits and packing lists for your next trip.
  • Wardrobe Score: Understand how effectively you use your wardrobe.
  • Complete the Look: Discover recommended fashion items from partner brands based on your style and budget.

Total Analysis

We map your entire closet to find hidden combinations you never thought possible.

Our Mission

Our mission is to make everyday styling effortless, affordable, personalized, and sustainable. We want to help people feel confident in what they wear while encouraging smarter fashion choices.

Speed & Ease

Get daily outfit suggestions instantly based on weather and your schedule.

What Makes STYLO Different

Unlike traditional fashion platforms that focus on selling new clothes, STYLO starts with what you already have. We combine personalized styling with technology to unlock more possibilities from your existing wardrobe.

Proven Tech

Thousands of successful outfits generated, refining your style with every use.

STYLE YOU CAN TRUST

Our Credibility

We combine advanced AI technology with human expertise to ensure your wardrobe reflects the best version of you.

Fashion with Purpose

We encourage smarter shopping decisions and making better use of clothes you already own.

Honest Recommendations

Providing transparent partner brand recommendations that genuinely fit your unique style.

Our Promise

Your style is personal. STYLO helps you explore it with greater confidence and ease.

Privacy Comes First
